relations.zotero_refs: [4TBERVZD]: 13. Incipit of instance (ID:6002): lus kyi bstan bcos bar pa tshad ma rnam nges kyi legs par bshad pa 'grel pa kun las buts pa'i snying po nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi snang ba zhes bya ba |. Colophon of instance (ID:6002), fol. 117b: 'grel bshad kun las btus pa'i snying po nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi snang ba zhes bya ba 'di | rigs par smra ba rin chen tshul khrims kyis mkhas grub du ma'i 'byung gnas ne'u thog chos gra chen por sbyar ba'o ||
relations.support_notes: There is little doubt that (ID:6002) is an instance of (ID:5271), although the incipit and colophon are not identical with those in instance (ID:5270).

comments:
Item kept at the Cultural Palace of Nationalities in Beijing (CPN), mentioned in <<van der Kuijp 1994 [4TBERVZD]>>: 13-14.
In view of the signature, it was part of the 'Bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang collection. [8H6M69W4] does not list any item with the signature "phyi zha 12."
